nodes.name: Patient-15
nodes.summary:
Patient-15, born July 10, 1969, case number URO-2026-0015, presented with a C61 Prostatakarzinom (cT2b cN0 cM0, Gleason 3+4=7, ISUP 2) and a biochemical recurrence following a radical prostatectomy (RPE). On January 14, 2027, Patient-15 underwent a robotic-assisted radical prostatectomy performed by Dr. med. Arzt-11 at the Urologische Klinik of Klinikum Bremen. Routine follow-ups through August 22, 2027, showed a stable, normal PSA of <0.1 ng/ml and an ECOG performance status of 0. On January 12, 2028, a follow-up examination revealed an upward trend in PSA to 0.2 ng/ml. By May 27, 2028, the PSA reached 0.9 ng/ml. On June 9, 2028, a PSMA-PET/CT showed focal increased tracer uptake in the prostate bed with no distant metastasis. On June 16, 2028, an interdisciplinary tumor board chaired by Dr. med.
